description: A bearded man in a dark long coat leans over a polished brass microscope on a wooden table, adjusting it with both hands. Behind him a crowd of men in dark suits and bow ties leans in to watch, and a tiered wooden gallery of seated men fills the back of the room. Shelves of glass jars line the wall, and the table holds glass specimen jars with preserved items, a brown glass bottle, a glass vial and slides. The setting looks like a 19th-century laboratory or lecture hall, in a dark, painterly oil style, with no legible letters or numbers. The painting fills the image edge to edge, and nothing is gory.
